nodes.asset_description: Large center-spanning 3D furry numerals '2004' in deep mauve/pink (approximately #b84b86 to #c25a95), soft directional shading and long hair-like fibers. The digits are arranged from left to right with the '2' on the far left, two rounded '0's in the middle, and a chunky '4' on the right. Edges are soft and fuzzy; subtle inner shadows on the holes of the zeros. Transparent background so the gray canvas shows through.

nodes.text: Finger foods, like mini sandwiches, fruit skewers, and cupcakes, are perfect for easy snacking. As for activities, there are endless possibilities, like karaoke, board games, and DIY crafts.

nodes.asset_description: Top-right polaroid-style photo with thick white border and soft drop shadow, rotated slightly clockwise. Close-up of a person in profile with light brown hair wearing a large green leafy earring, neutral background.

Bottom-left polaroid-style photo with white frame and soft shadow, rotated slightly counterclockwise. Scene by a swimming pool: two people standing near metallic fringe backdrop; visible legs and footwear beside the pool edge.
Center-bottom polaroid-style photo with white frame and soft shadow, rotated slightly clockwise. Person in a light purple outfit seated on a sofa, arms extended forward, dark green wall behind.
